panel.subtitulo: Clear guidance for purchasing, participating and requesting help safely.
panel.descripcion: Select a category to read only the rules you need.
panel.nota: The version published by the administration team is always the current one.

generales.descripcion: Respectful behavior and proper use of the server.

contenido: Treat every member and staff member with respect.
Harassment, discrimination, threats and offensive content are not allowed.
Avoid personal disputes and use each channel for its intended purpose.
Do not spam, flood or advertise without permission.
Do not share malicious, deceptive or inappropriate content.
Respect moderation decisions and use support if you wish to appeal.

compras.descripcion: A safe process for quotes, payments and deliveries.

contenido: Confirm the product, scope, price and delivery time in the ticket.
Use only the payment methods and accounts provided by authorized staff.
Do not close the ticket until every detail has been checked.
Keep the conversation and payment evidence inside the ticket.
Explain changes clearly; additional work may require a revised quote.
Report any impersonation attempt to the administration team immediately.

soporte.descripcion: How to get help quickly and efficiently.

contenido: Choose the correct category and summarize the issue in the subject.
Include context, screenshots and error messages whenever possible.
Do not repeatedly mention staff; the system notifies the team automatically.
Reply in the same ticket and avoid opening duplicates.
Never post private data or complete credentials.
Confirm that the solution worked before closing the case.
Enable two-factor authentication on Discord.
Staff will never need your password, bot token or 2FA code.
Check server roles before trusting direct messages.
Save screenshots, IDs and links to suspicious messages.
Open a support ticket and avoid confronting the user publicly.
Change your credentials immediately if you believe they were exposed.
